name: Alp
notes: CR 2. Dream-riding spirit. Session 1 vault. Campaign-custom.
gm_notes: Session 1 vault, dream sequence. Can only be harmed while attached to a sleeping creature or if that creature wakes (the Alp becomes visible and tangible for 1 round). Enters sleeping victims via Nightmare Touch -- target makes DC 13 WIS save or takes 2d6 psychic and is frightened until waking. The cold open dream in Session 1 is this creature's work.
